title: Specterite
description: This changes netherite to specterite, a nice looking bluish ore.
body:
This resource pack changes netherite to a bluish nice-looking ore called Specterite. You should use this with my other resource pack called "Specterite Armor and Other Extensions". Idk why the armor model stuff doesn't work when it's in this file lol.

This was (kinda) forked from lunar_7's texture pack from 2022 on planetmc.
lunar_7's original texture pack: https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/specterite-blue-netherite/

I will probably keep updating this in the future.

This one will only change:
- The model of items
- The image of items in the inventory
- The texture of all netherite stuff to specterite


The [Specterite Armor Models and Other Extensions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/specterite-armor-models-and-other-extensions) resource pack will add the following features:
- Replace almost all instances of the word "Netherite" with "Specterite"
- Change the armor model of netherite armor to specterite armor
